description: This file defines an interface named WebDocument which specifies methods for external API interactions related to document storage, including upload, download, share, delete, and search operations.

methods.name: uploadDoc
methods.description: Uploads a document associated with a bean, providing file, name, and MIME type.

methods.name: downloadDoc
methods.description: Downloads a document given its ID and format.

methods.name: shareDoc
methods.description: Shares a document via email addresses.

methods.name: deleteDoc
methods.description: Deletes a document by its ID.

methods.name: searchDoc
methods.description: Searches documents based on keywords, optionally flushing the document cache.
